# `Log`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Log — structured observability kernels.

Four severity levels — `debug` / `info` / `warn` / `error` — write a
single-line message to the structured log.  The `*With` variants attach
an ordered list of context values alongside the message.  Each value must
be a `String`, `Int`, `Float`, `Bool` or `Char` (all of one type per list);
anything else is refused at type-check (IPE-T0014) — convert it first
(`String.fromInt`, `Error.toString`, `Secret.redacted`, a record's fields).

`Log.level` is the runtime-config front door for the minimum log
severity.  It takes a `LogLevel` constructor from `Ipe.Level`
(`Level.debug` / `Level.info` / `Level.warn` / `Level.error`) and
produces a cross-shape `Setting a` value for inclusion in an app's
settings list.

Line printing to stdout / stderr lives in `Ipe.Io` (`Io.println` /
`Io.eprintln`), not here.

## `level`

```ipe
level : LogLevel -> Setting a
```

Set the minimum log severity for the application.  Takes a `LogLevel`
constructor from `Ipe.Level` and returns a cross-shape `Setting a` for
use in an app's settings list.

    import Ipe.Level as Level

    warnAndAbove : Setting a
    warnAndAbove =
        Log.level Level.warn

and list it among the settings: `Web.appWith [ warnAndAbove ] app`.
